text: The Company's mine holding costs are primarily comprised of labour costs associated with care and maintenance staff, electricity, security, environmental and community support costs for the following mines which are currently under temporary suspension:
(1) During the year ended December 31, 2025, the Company announced that it has entered into a definitive agreement to sell its 100%-owned, past-producing Del Toro Silver Mine (Note 15 ).

(2) The Company resumed operations at the Santa Elena mine during the year, having previously processed ore exclusively from the Ermitaño mine, with both mines forming part of the Santa Elena operation.
